_meta.description: Held-out variant ground truth for SentinelMesh Step 6. One entry per variant S1-S9. Each variant keeps the same planted weakness, target container and expected MITRE technique as its base scenario, and changes only the method. 'expected_detection' is the PREDICTED behaviour of the frozen detectors, written before running (not a target to engineer): 'fires' if the frozen rule/detector still catches the variant, 'gap' if it does not.
lab_adaptations: S1: UNION injection instead of a MySQL SLEEP() blind payload, because the lab DB is PostgreSQL (SLEEP() errors -> result=failure, which the S1 detector ignores).
S3: the seeded testuser/testpass account instead of W4's 'postgres_backup', because the lab only seeds admin and testuser (services/database/init.sql).
S4: HS384 token signed with the lab's known hardcoded secret; models an attacker who recovered the secret.
S8: egress from the database container (busybox wget/nc), which is the container the S8 rule does not watch.
S9: a decoy /root/.ssh/id_rsa is planted before the read, so there is a real file to steal.

S1.variant: UNION-based SQL injection (vs original boolean OR)
S1.reason: S1 detector matches UNION / quote / -- in the logged payload; the UNION returns a row so result=success.

S2.variant: Distributed password spray, one failed attempt across six accounts
S2.reason: S2 detector thresholds on 5 failures for the SAME identifier within 30s; a spray never concentrates on one identifier.

S3.variant: Login with the seeded testuser/testpass account (vs admin/admin123)
S3.reason: S3 detector only flags username=admin; testuser is a real seeded weak account it was not written for.

S4.variant: Forged HS384 token signed with the lab secret (vs alg:none)
S4.reason: S4 detector matches only result=valid with algorithm=none; an HS384 valid verification is missed.

S5.variant: Postgres connection from a different ephemeral client image/query
S5.reason: S5 rule flags any inbound accept on database:5432 from a source not in the allowlist, regardless of client.

S6.variant: In-place truncation/shred of a log file (vs echo append)
S6.reason: S6 rule flags any open-for-write under /var/log/sentinelmesh/ in logcollector, regardless of process.

S7.variant: Anonymous scrape of a different Grafana API path (/api/search)
S7.reason: S7 detector flags any GET to /api/* or /d/* returning 200 with no authenticated identity.

S8.variant: Egress to an external host from the database container (vs webapp)
S8.reason: S8 rule only watches the webapp and authservice containers; egress from the database container is not covered.

S9.reason: S9 rule covers /root/.ssh/* for any process, so reading the SSH key is still flagged.
